Chapter 7140: Origination Dao

Chapter 7140: Origination Dao

“Impossible, His Excellency Kun Peng and the others would obey someone else’s command?” Stone Immortal became startled.

Moreover, they had five members and control over Divine Firmament’s resources. This secret grove has been accumulating for epochs, allowing them to deal with any powerful foe.

“Well, perhaps, no one truly knows.” The monarch sighed in response.

“Do you know who it is?” Stone Immortal couldn’t help asking.

“The answer might be revealed soon.” The monarch answered.

The dragon servants and other inhabitants stared intensely at Kun Peng. Were their masters actually followers? This only shattered their faith and belief even more.

“Elder, we have nothing more to say then, we don’t need you.” Kun Peng said before shouting: “Eat this!”

“Boom!” He turned into a dao of chaos.

“Origination Dao.” Apex and Hao Cai were startled upon seeing the divine beast’s innate gift.

The twenty-four layers of Divine Firmament became one of chaos. Kun Peng utilized his dao and prepared to fight one against the three primordial immortals.

All of Divine Firmament became their enemy, forcing them to run. However, running was impossible in this scenario.

After seeing this innate gift, it became clear that Kun Peng was stronger than a primordial immortal. He was on his way across the ocean.

“Retreat!” Worldbearer shouted and took action.

His shell became resplendent and conjured a shield as tall as the high heaven and sturdy enough to block its attack.

“Heaven Bearer!” Big shots shouted in astonishment upon seeing Worldbrearer’s innate gift.

The primordial immortals thought this was the strongest defense in existence, created solely to stop the high heaven. It brought them enough time to run back to the turtle’s side.

Meanwhile, Origination Dao crashed against the shield, wielding Kun Peng’s power and Divine Firmament’s weight. Nonetheless, the shield remained standing.

Worldbearer staggered backward, feeling his vitality churning.

Everyone could tell Worldbearer had slightly lost the exchange, unable to fully stop Origination Dao.

“The strongest of the divine beasts, I see...” Stone Immortal said.
